verdict.rationale: Cursor supports fleet-scale automation: launching many parallel cloud agents/subagents, CLI scripting with `find | while read` loops piping files into agent calls, headless print mode with JSON output for scripting, and the Cloud Agents API for programmatically launching/managing many agents across repos. However, this is oriented toward parallel agent tasks/PRs rather than a native 'bulk operations across many items' UI primitive (e.g., no documented bulk-select-and-edit across files/tickets in one action). missing for 10: a first-party bulk-operation UI/API explicitly scoped to acting on many discrete items (files, PRs, tickets) in a single invocation, and independent hands-on evidence confirming reliability at scale.
